options.name: config
options.description: Config in XML format. Required if job does not yet exist. Mutually exclusive with O(enabled). Considered if O(state=present).

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the job should be enabled or disabled. Mutually exclusive with O(config). Considered if O(state=present).

options.name: password
options.description: Password to authenticate with the Jenkins server.

options.name: state
options.description: Attribute that specifies if the job has to be created or deleted.

options.name: token
options.description: API token used to authenticate alternatively to password.

options.name: url
options.description: URL where the Jenkins server is accessible.

options.name: user
options.description: User to authenticate with the Jenkins server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to V(false), the SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to V(false) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates as it avoids verifying the source site. The C(python-jenkins) library only handles this by using the environment variable E(PYTHONHTTPSVERIFY).
